profile.label: Profile
profile.hint: Each profile keeps its own passwords, addresses and cards. The buttons below open those of the profile chosen here; the switches count for all of them.

passwords.title: Passwords
passwords.offer_hint: After you sign in, Magnetite asks whether to keep the password and fills it in the next time. Saved passwords stay on this computer, outside sync.
passwords.test_key: This run uses Chromium's test key (--mock-keychain): what it saves is not protected by your keychain.
passwords.breach: Warn about passwords from data breaches
passwords.breach_hint: While this is on, Chromium asks a Google service at each sign-in whether the password appeared in a known breach. It sends an encrypted fragment, not the password.

forms.title: Forms
forms.addresses_hint: Names, addresses, phone numbers and email addresses for forms. Magnetite asks before it saves one.
forms.cards: Save and fill in payment cards
forms.cards_hint: Card details for checkout forms, kept on this computer. Magnetite asks before it saves one.

footer: The lists are Chromium's own pages; they open over this one. The extension of a password manager such as Bitwarden works next to all this, or in its place.
